description: The two reserved tag matches, which a port that only searches the `tags` array will miss entirely: a rune matches its own `spirit.name` used as a tag, and it matches `glyph:<its glyph>`. Adjacency of two atoms is an implicit AND, so `glyph:task status:live` means both. These are the rules in `vc_rune_has_tag`, and they are why a tag expression can select 'that one rune' or 'everything of this kind' without any tag being authored.
